name: sap-llm-gateway
description: A proxy that allows applications to use OpenAI, Anthropic, and AWS Bedrock API formats to access SAP AI Core Foundation Models.
license: GNU AGPLv3 License - see the LICENSE file for details.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { require('./scripts/setup-git-hooks.js') } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sap-llm-gateway/test-utils build && pnpm --filter @sap-llm-gateway/service-key-parser build && pnpm run --recursive build
scripts.clean:all: pnpm run clean && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name 'pnpm-lock.yaml' -delete
scripts.db:dev-setup: cd admin-db-export && pnpm install && pnpm run dev:setup

pnpm.comment: Production CVE patches via overrides: axios 1.16.1 (CVE-2026-42264/44488/44494/44495/44496/44486/44487 — proxy/cookie/redirect/ReDoS), qs 6.15.2 (CVE-2026-8723 — transitive via express/body-parser; supersedes the earlier 6.15.0 pin), form-data >=4.0.6 <5 (HIGH — transitive via axios), http-proxy-middleware >=3.0.7 <4 (HIGH — the gateway's own proxy middleware), jws 3.2.3 (CVE-2025-65945 — HMAC verification, transitive via jsonwebtoken@9 in admin and @sap/xssec), fast-uri 3.1.2 (CVE-2026-6321/6322 — path traversal + host confusion via ajv in admin), shell-quote >=1.8.4 (CVE-2026-9277 — dev-only via npm-run-all, patched to keep the Dependabot dashboard clean). js-yaml is bounded >=4.2.0 <5.0.0 — the floor is a CVE patch, the <5 ceiling is required because js-yaml 5.x is ESM-only with no default export and breaks @ui5/project's `import jsyaml from 'js-yaml'` during the UI5 build. Other bounded overrides (express/body-parser/path-to-regexp/router/cookie/send/serve-static/tmp/got/tar/minimatch/follow-redirects) are silent CVE patches; lodash/underscore/ws/flatted/undici are single-major dev-only patches added to clear the Dependabot dashboard (none ship to production). @cap-js/* pins are supply-chain attack guards from April 2025 (NOT CVE patches). Dev-only acceptances (still in tree, not shipped to production): glob 10.4.5 via copyfiles+@ui5/mcp-server (cannot upgrade without breaking copyfiles@2.4.1 ESM gap), path-to-regexp 0.1.13 ReDoS (router@2.x compat, route patterns are static), plus 50+ transitive dev highs through @ui5/mcp-server, nodemon, npm-run-all, ts-jest, eslint, @babel/preset-env, ui5-tooling-modules, @sap/ux-ui5-tooling — none ship to Docker images or the npm tarball. After changing overrides, run `node cli-tools/refresh-dist-lockfiles.js` to refresh the docker/ and npm-dist/ lockfiles so Dependabot rescans the patched versions.
